name: Sensor view counts parts and Escape leaves it

planSteps.description: Stay on the page that is already open at the start URL and do not navigate to any other address: the chart is on that page. Wait 4 seconds for the chart to settle
Click the 'TestSprite view' button in the top bar
Verify the bottom strip reads 'Sensor view. N parts found.' where N is a whole number greater than 0, and the top-bar button now says 'Human view'
Verify the strip starting 'Sensor view.' is gone and the top-bar button says 'TestSprite view' again
